articles.title: Qualcomm (QCOM) Unveils First AI Native Wi Fi 8 Gateway For Home Broadband
articles.description: Qualcomm (NasdaqGS:QCOM) and broadband partners announced the world's first AI native Wi Fi 8 gateway for home networks. The new gateway is built on Qualcomm's latest platform that combines next generation Wi Fi 8 connectivity with on device edge AI compute. The product targets residential broadband providers looking to add agentic AI services directly in the home rather than relying only on cloud compute.
